system.description: A Focus for a character who earns a living through practical work, resilience, and useful expertise.

abilities.name: Fitting In
abilities.description: Blend into a community of ordinary intelligent creatures so you attract little notice until you draw attention to yourself.

abilities.name: Handy
abilities.description: You are trained in crafting and gain one extra resource point whenever you gain resources, usable only for crafting or repairs.

abilities.name: Muscles of Iron
abilities.description: Until a ten-minute or longer recovery, ease all Might actions other than attacks.

abilities.name: Danger Instinct
abilities.description: When surprised by an attack or hazard, move an immediate distance before it occurs; if it still reaches you, ease your defense.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: Double or halve physical-action durations, whichever benefits you, with harmful effects lasting at least one round.

abilities.name: Eye for Detail
abilities.description: After carefully exploring a nearby area or accessible object for about five minutes, ask the GM one question and receive a truthful answer.

abilities.name: Improvise
abilities.description: When attempting an untrained task, improvise a tool, insight, or lucky break to gain an asset.

abilities.name: Device Insight
abilities.description: Ask the GM one question about an unfamiliar or advanced device's capabilities, operation, weaknesses, or repair.

abilities.name: Hard-Won Resilience
abilities.description: Your difficult experiences grant you enough resilience to withstand one additional moderate wound.

abilities.name: Polymath
abilities.description: When rolling a trained non-attack, non-defense task below 12, treat the result as 12.

abilities.name: Expert Handyman
abilities.description: Objects you craft, repair, or build with resources are superior, typically functioning as if two levels higher.

abilities.name: On the Crew
abilities.description: With at least two allies, give the team a short pep talk that grants a temporary group benefit until a ten-minute or longer recovery.
